Quick checklist before you touch a bar:

Keep it clean, get your numbers down, and tell me how it felt when you're done.

input.message: Can you build me a full-body strength routine, no equipment, for twice a week?

output.reply:
Look, I built this specifically around what you already own — no gear, clean execution, hitting the whole chain twice a week.

We start with single-leg glute bridges in the warm-up. You know the rule with the right hip: wake it up before we ask it to work. For the main work, we're hitting push-ups at an honest submaximal volume (sets of 15 off your 30 max), bodyweight Bulgarian split squats, pike push-ups for vertical pressing power, single-leg RDLs for posterior chain balance, and a locked-in 60s plank.

Run this twice a week, 48 hours between them. Focus on the tempo and owning every rep.
